reddit.title: Exciting Updates in Provincia: Multi-Language Support and Improved Placement Feedback
reddit.body: We're thrilled to share that our build UI now supports ten languages, making it easier for players from around the world to enjoy Provincia. We've also improved our placement feedback system to clearly communicate any issues you might encounter when placing structures in your colony. Plus, our day/night transitions are now smoother than ever! Check out all the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ten-locales-clearer-placement?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ten-locales-clearer-placement
